_note: Sample data. Used by demo mode and by scripts/generate-seed.mjs to build supabase/seed.sql. All names and stories are fictional.

prayers.name: Margaret
prayers.request: Please pray for my husband Tom. He has heart surgery on Thursday and we are both scared. Pray for steady hands for the surgeons and peace for our family while we wait.

prayers.name: Anonymous
prayers.request: I have been waking up at 3 a.m. every night with my heart racing. I know God is with me but my mind will not rest. Please pray for peace and for sleep.

prayers.name: David
prayers.request: I lost my job last month after twelve years. I have two kids and the savings are running low. Pray that God opens the right door and that I trust Him while I wait.

prayers.name: Linda
prayers.request: My daughter and I have not spoken in two years. I miss her every day. Please pray that God softens both our hearts and brings us back together.

prayers.name: Anonymous
prayers.request: My mother went home to be with the Lord last week. I know she is with Jesus, but the house is so quiet. Please pray for comfort for me and my brothers.

prayers.name: James
prayers.request: I have been offered a job in another state. It would mean leaving our church and our friends. Please pray for wisdom and clear direction for my wife and me.

prayers.name: Rosa
prayers.request: Please pray for my son Michael. He walked away from the faith in college. I believe God is still chasing him. Pray that he comes home to Jesus.

prayers.name: Anonymous
prayers.request: I have been sober for 90 days. Some days are harder than others. Please pray that I stay strong and keep leaning on God one day at a time.

prayers.name: Ruth
prayers.request: I start chemotherapy next week. Pray for strength for my body, few side effects, and that I would feel God close to me in the hard days.

prayers.name: Carlos
prayers.request: My wife and I are struggling in our marriage. We still love each other but we keep hurting each other. Pray that we would learn to forgive and put God at the center of our home.

prayers.name: Grace
prayers.request: I am graduating in the spring and I do not know what is next. Please pray that I follow where God is leading and not just what looks safe.

prayers.name: Anonymous
prayers.request: This is private. Please pray for me as I face a hard conversation with my doctor next week. I would rather not share the details publicly.

testimonies.name: Margaret
testimonies.answer: Tom came through surgery with no complications. The surgeon said it went better than expected. We felt your prayers in that waiting room. Thank You, Jesus.

testimonies.name: Anonymous
testimonies.prayedFor: A way to pay our rent after my hours were cut.
testimonies.answer: A neighbor I barely knew knocked on our door with an envelope. It covered the rent to the dollar. She said God put us on her heart. I cried the whole night.

testimonies.name: Peter
testimonies.prayedFor: My brother to come back to church.
testimonies.answer: After ten years away, my brother walked into church with me on Easter Sunday. He has come every week since. God never gave up on him.

testimonies.name: Joy
testimonies.prayedFor: Peace in the middle of panic attacks.
testimonies.answer: The panic attacks have not disappeared overnight, but they are fewer and softer. I pray Philippians 4:6-7 every morning now. God is teaching me to breathe and trust Him.

testimonies.name: Samuel
testimonies.prayedFor: A new job after being laid off.
testimonies.answer: I got the call this morning. Full-time, better hours, and closer to home. I start Monday. Praise God!
